My name is Christina. I am working in New Delhi. Thiruvalla is my native place. This is my mother, this is my
child, this is my husband. I am testifying about the greatest blessing Mother Mary has given in my life.
It was in 2023 that I got married. After one year of marriage, God gave me a precious son. After one year, when I became pregnant, I was
in my hometown, undergoing treatment. The normal scanning was done, everything was without any problem, everything was going smoothly. But during the fifth month
anomaly scanning, we received the most heartbreaking news. The doctor said the baby had CDH, that is Left Congenital
Diaphragmatic Hernia. On the left side of the baby, there is a membrane. In that membrane a hole had formed, and the baby’s stomach and intestines moved upward to the left side.
Because of that, the baby’s left lung was very small. The baby would struggle to breathe. If the baby was born, the survival chance was below 30
percent, the doctor said. We had no idea how it would be. The doctor said, “It’s only five months, you can go for abortion.”
To abort a baby we had waited for so long was the most painful thing in our life. I said, I
will not do an abortion. I had only one word in my heart. Jesus has said, “It is I who gave life; it
is not for you to take it away.”Mother brought me this far, whatever happens, I firmly believed She will give me this child.
The doctor said, I can refer you to two or three hospitals. The doctor referred me to two or three hospitals. They did many tests. But,
after doing all the tests, all the doctors had only one statement: abortion. No one could figure out what else to do. But I did not give up my faith. I told Mother,
Mother, if this is the child You have given me, then please hand it over to me alive. I took the covenant online because,
I was in Delhi. At that time, I had no way to come here and take the covenant. So I took it online and prayed. I said, I will listen to Daily Bread, and
I would get up at that exact time and listen to Daily Bread. I don’t know why, but after listening, I felt a great strength that day. Whatever prayer Father would say,
in every covenant meditation Father says one line: when we pray — O Mother, Kreupasanam Mother of blessings, make me a witness of Your apparition.
This was the one sentence I would say every morning and evening, whether sitting idle or praying. That was the only sentence I kept repeating in my heart.
I don’t know from where such strength came to me, I don’t know. Whatever I was doing, my mother would say: do not be troubled. I said, I am not troubled.
If my Mother has said She will give me my child, then She will give me my child. Then I came to Kreupasanam to see Father, but I could not see him.
I went before the perpetual adoration there, laid down all the baby’s test reports, and prayed: Mother,
if You give me my child without any problem, I will come here and testify. Holding my child close, I will give testimony, Mother, I said.
Then a second time, I came again, met Father, and prayed. When I prayed, Father did not say anything to me. Father just turned, placed his hand on my head,
prayed, and walked away. I did not know what to do. Crying, I called out, “Father!” When Father
came, I said, Father, the doctors are telling me to do abortion. I don’t know what to do, Father.
Father, the doctors are telling me to do abortion. I don’t know what to do, Father, I said. Then Father turned, looked at Mother, prayed,
then turned back, patted my cheek and said: Don’t cry. Pray and go do a scan. The Lord will show you a sign, he said. With that one faith,
I went and did the scan. The scanning report, which earlier said less than 30% chance the baby will survive, was corrected and rewritten as 60% chance
that the baby will survive. But even then, there was still a hurdle. The doctor said, survival chance is 60%, but we can do a surgery.
If you want, we can do a surgery right now itself and save the child. But for us, being a simple family, that was very difficult.
It was a very big surgery. The doctor said, before the month is over, we can surgically take out the baby from my womb and then do a surgery for the baby.
They said into that hole of the baby, they can insert a ball. The price of that ball itself was one lakh rupees. Altogether the surgery would cost about nine lakh rupees.
Even then, the doctor said, there is no 100% survival chance. In the end, I didn’t know what to do. I began to pray, I began to pray to Mother continuously.
I started listening to all of Father’s Daily Bread talks, I started listening to testimonies. Then I heard one testimony here,
a brother’s testimony — his child had the same sickness as mine, and when he came here, Mother saved that child completely healthy.
When I heard that testimony, my husband told me: you keep praying, your prayer will be heard by Mother. Then we went to Vandanam Hospital,
saw the doctor. The doctor said: pray. There are surgeries for this, but only prayer, only prayer can save you.
From there, we were referred to S.I.T. Hospital in Trivandrum. We went to Trivandrum, and the doctor explained everything in detail,
explained the seriousness of it. All the doctors said the same thing: the baby’s survival chance is very low. Yes, we can do surgery, but above everything,
there is God — that was what the doctor told me. So we prayed. When the eighth month came, my BP became very high. When BP became very high, I did not know what to do.
When we went there, the doctor said: we cannot keep waiting anymore, we must do the delivery now. So,
on February 28th, I gave birth to my baby through normal delivery. But when the baby was born, her weight was only 2.1 kilograms.
When I was going through labor pains, I was terribly afraid. When they admitted me into the labor room, I was lying there crying and
telling Mother: Mother, tell them to do a cesarean for me, I am scared. But the doctor said: we will not do a cesarean, we can deliver the baby through normal delivery itself.
Then I prayed to Mother: Mother, You must be with me. The pain, I am afraid of it, I said.
I don’t know, from the time my pain started, only Mother’s prayers - "Most Merciful Mother" , Apostles creed and the  prayer “O Holy Mother, Kreupasanam Mother of Favors.”
“Make me a witness of your apparition.” Apart from these three prayers, no other prayer or even a cry came out of my mouth.
The doctor asked, “Why are you like this?” I said, “I don’t know, my Mother is with me. I just keep praying this,” and while bearing the pain…
Crying, whenever I prayed, my pain would reduce to half. And so, on February 28 at 11:30, I…
gave birth to my baby. Immediately, they took her straight to NICU. The doctors had said the baby would be kept in NICU for 48 hours, and only if she breathed on her own…
would they do the surgery. After 48 hours, the doctor said, “We can do the surgery.” So they took the baby…
for surgery. At that time, I didn’t get to see my baby’s face. The surgery lasted three and a half hours—it was a major surgery.
During those three and a half hours, I held to my chest a blessed medal Father had given me, and I told Mother: “Mother, you have brought me this far…
…now you must give me my child.” And Mother said to me: “You keep praying, do not let go of your prayer.”
So we prayed. After the three and a half hour surgery, the doctor came out and said: “The surgery is successful, but until 48 hours pass…
…we cannot say anything. Only after 48 hours can we know. Because in the place where they said there was a hole, there was actually no hole…
…they just stitched from here and there. The surgery is over, but we cannot say survival chances. Wait 48 hours.”
I told Mother: “No, my Mother will give me my child. I have decided that I will come to Kreupasanam and give testimony…”
“…so Mother, make that possible for me.” The doctor who had said “48 hours” called us after just 24 hours…
and said: “The baby is responding to the medicine. There is no problem.” After 10 days, they said we could hold the baby in our hands.
In fact, on the 5th day itself, the doctor said: “You can take the baby home.” I always used to light candle prayers. When I did the covenant online…
…I would always send prayers to my husband. My husband works in Delhi. Both of us were in Delhi earlier, but I had come to my native place.
So my husband used to send me testimonies. My dad had also taken the covenant. After taking the covenant…
…whenever dad prayed the apparition prayer, we both would join and pray together with him.
Whether in the evening or night, the three of us prayed together. Through just that one prayer, I don’t know how, Mother…
…lifted my faith and made me her witness. That is my greatest joy. Because I prayed just like any ordinary person would…
…but today, how many people I am able to reach with Mother’s testimony, to so many people I am sharing it.
When the baby was in NICU, we couldn’t take any covenant items inside. Nothing could be brought in. But…
…my dad gave me a drop of blessed oil and said: “Use this for the baby.” So without the doctors noticing, I anointed her with that oil…
…and the very moment I anointed her, for the first time I heard my baby cry. Until then, I hadn’t heard even a single whimper.
The mother of the child who was lying next to me said, “Sister, what is that? Can you give me some too?” Then I thought, this is an opportunity for me to
speak about Mother Mary. I said, “I went to Kreupasanam and prayed, and that is how I received her. Just apply this holy oil, that is enough.” Their child had
a very big issue. So they applied the oil and prayed. Then on the twentieth day we were discharged. Still, the doctor said, “The lungs of the child, which should
have grown inside the womb, will be fully developed only after one and a half years. The child has a chance of infection. Do not let the child be close to anyone.
Whenever we take the child, we must be that careful,” they said. “There will be delay in gaining weight, and delay in drinking milk,” they also said. But I said,
“My Mother will not abandon me.” Now they are saying, “That child was born one and a half months premature, so even in rolling over, or in any activity that
a normal baby does, this child will only do it late.” But today, after six months are completed, my child has started to roll over, started to crawl slowly,
and has begun to respond to us. During the time when I was pregnant, this child never moved in the womb, which made us afraid. But whenever we sat down to
pray, whenever we sang songs to Mother, my child would kick in the womb.
Isn’t that amazing? Even today, when we three sit together for family prayer, when we sing Mother’s songs, or when we recite “O Mary, full of grace,” she will
murmur in her own language. I don’t know what that is. If we sing any other song, she will not react. But after Mother’s song is sung, she will look straight
into our eyes. This is truly a child given by Mother. That is why I had said, if
I get a baby girl, I will add Mother’s name to her name. So I did receive a baby
girl, and I have named her Hazel Maria Liju.
The meaning of the word Hazel is “God sees.” God has seen and heard my prayer. And so, it is this golden child that my God has given me. While we were in Delhi,
we would not get the prayer newsletters from here. But if it was available there, sometimes people would keep it in churches. I was working in the Delhi Archdiocese,
in the Bishop’s House as a civil engineer. So whenever I got the leaflet, my husband and I would take it, and then pass it on to the people nearby, so that as many
people as possible could receive Mother’s blessings, or hear the testimonies of the Gospel. That is what I was doing continually. Perhaps all these blessings are
the reason why Mother chose me—
someone so lowly—and lifted me close to her heart. I have a thousand thanks for that. No matter how much I thank Mother, it will never be enough. For giving me my
child in such good health, Mother, I give you a thousand thanks.
Mother, praise be to you. Mother, glory to you. Mother…  1 Samuel, Chapter 1, verses 26 to 28. Hannah said,
“Pardon me, my lord. As surely as you live, I am the woman who stood here beside you praying to the Lord. I prayed for this child, and the Lord has granted me
what I asked of him. So now I give him to the Lord.” This daughter, Christina Stephen, has offered her life of covenant online with a very God-filled testimony at the
feet of the Mother. Truly, it is a testimony of great suffering and trials she endured.
She was sharing, with intensity and joy, about the life of consecration and covenant.
When she told me this in the prayer tent, I asked her, “Have you ever had your faith shaken? Have you ever felt your prayers were of no use or been distressed?”
To each question, Christina told me, “My faith never wavered — not even once.”
“My faith did not tremble,” she said, “because I had such trust in Mother of Kreupasanam; Mother will not abandon me. I know God gives and God takes.”
“I have read that in the Holy Scripture. If Mother takes it, I would have no problem; but if Mother places the child in my arms, she will give it back in full health.”
“From the very beginning I had that faith, and so I was never distressed.”
“Even when, at home, everyone would ask if I needed anything, I would say: ‘Nothing — Mother formed this; it is Mother’s doing.’ ”
“By the fifth month, everything that happened reminded me that I had decided to live united with Mother; therefore…”
“…I believed that Mother would place the child in my arms in good health. Dear ones, this is what steadfast faith means.”
“When life contains only vows of consecration, yet all the visible doctors — after visiting six or seven hospitals — kept repeating ‘abortion’…”
“…and those around began to speak like that, I did not accept any of it; if God has formed this, then it belongs to Mother, and I offer it to Her.”
“By surrendering it, I was certain that Mother would provide and help with whatever my life and the child in my womb needed.”
“With full surrender the daughter carried this child in her womb. This is a very challenging faith, because I will not collapse and I will not turn back.”
“I will continually glorify my Mother; to be a witness to the apparition of the covenant, I will carry this child in my womb until the last moment.”
“Until the final moment I will carry her. Dear ones, this is testimony that glorifies God’s name before people.”
“She says: When I was in Delhi we didn’t get the Covenant newsletters here, but sometimes people would leave them in churches.”
“I would collect each one and lovingly distribute them, telling everyone about Mother — this was my covenant.”
“Are we sure that blessings will surely come? This family’s testimony shared at this altar is proof of that — of the great divine experience this family received.”
“Let us give thanks, clap our hands, and present this testimony — may these extraordinary divine experiences be yours as well.”
“If you haven’t subscribed to this YouTube channel yet, subscribe now, and share this video with your friends.”
“And become witnesses of the Lord.”
